basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Long Island, NY. I've been exploring virtual worlds since the early 2000s and have a particular fondness for survival and strategy games. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm usually found gaming or attending local indie music gigs. Currently single and enjoying the freedom of gaming marathons over the weekends. I am usually online in the evenings and late nights, especially on Fridays and Saturdays.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the software development industry for over a decade. Gaming is both a hobby and a passion; I've built my gaming knowledge through countless hours of gameplay and active participation in gaming communities.
